## 0.7.3

- Using a terminal no longer crashes the game. Since 0.7.0 the plugin looked at what a terminal is linked to (its door or safe) and read entries the engine had not resolved yet as pointers; the Red Rocket terminal crashed both players every time (reported on Nexus for 0.7.1).
- A terminal's safe or door stays in sync even when the hack and the menus take minutes (the watch on a used object lasts five minutes instead of one).
- Protocol unchanged: 0.7.0 to 0.7.3 play together.
